clue.text: Short piece of music, one of low points

parts.note: a minim is a note lasting half a semibreve, a brief piece of music
A is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: A musical miniature is described as one of the quiet troughs in a performance.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of minimum, the lowest values a curve or quantity reaches.

clue.text: Performed live, reel produces musical awakening

indicators.note: the letters are performed, played over in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A live performance of a reel serves as a lively wake-up tune.
explanation.definitionFit: The bugle call sounded at dawn to rouse soldiers is a wake-up played on an instrument.

clue.text: Did badly to take vehicle inside pass

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take the vehicle in, holding it inside them
done badly, the letters of the word are jumbled

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone who drove badly had their car taken inside a compound and needed a pass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' scrambles the first word to IDD; 'to take' and 'inside' both signal the vehicle going within it. 'pass' is a noun, an entry permit.
explanation.definitionFit: An identity card is a document that serves as a pass for entry.

clue.text: Interval between notes that soared in sober hearts

indicators.note: the reversed word is placed inside the letters for sober

parts.note: TT, teetotal, means sober

indicators.note: in a down clue a word that soared rises up the column, so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: soared means flew
H is the card-game abbreviation for hearts

explanation.surface: Music that soared moved the hearts of sober listeners.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'that soared' sends the word for flew upward, so it reads WELF. TT (teetotal) is a standard crossword sober.
explanation.definitionFit: An interval spanning an octave plus a fifth is named by counting twelve scale degrees.

clue.text: Moving auditory experience for those that love silence

parts.note: who means those that, as a relative pronoun
love is nil in tennis, the letter O
SH is the call for silence

explanation.surface: A puzzle: what sound do lovers of quiet find moving?
explanation.definitionFit: The rushing sound of something speeding past is a noise heard as it moves.

clue.text: One stopped and added: "That isn't ever even"

indicators.note: the even-numbered letters, second, fourth and so on, are taken from the words before

explanation.surface: Someone stopped by the police adds a protest that something is never level.
explanation.walkthrough: Take every second letter of 'added That isn't ever': D,E,T,A,I,N,E,E.
explanation.definitionFit: A person held in custody has been stopped and kept by the authorities.

clue.text: Red wine splashed across first cover

indicators.note: the jumbled letters spread across the other piece, enclosing it
splashed about, the letters are scattered into a new order

parts.note: do is the first note of the sol-fa scale, which the across clues climb through

explanation.surface: Red wine is spilt over the bedding at the very start.
explanation.walkthrough: The across clues climb the sol-fa scale DO, RE, MI and so on: 'first' is DO, and each 'next' is the following note. EIDERWN from the shuffled wine goes round DO.
explanation.definitionFit: A quilt filled with duck feathers is a bed cover.

clue.text: Article about next number

indicators.note: the article goes about the note, enclosing it

parts.note: the is the definite article
the note after do in the sol-fa scale is re

explanation.surface: A writer's piece concerns the next issue of a magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: Each 'next' in the across clues is the following sol-fa note after the last one used.
explanation.definitionFit: A cardinal numeral, one more than two.

clue.text: Base the next on what might be of use — it's flawless

parts.note: the next note in the sol-fa scale after re is mi

indicators.note: being without a flaw, the word loses its vice

parts.note: something serviceable might be of use
it's a flaw: vice, standing for the flaw taken out

explanation.surface: A recommendation to build the next thing on something useful, since it's perfect.
explanation.walkthrough: SERVICEABLE without VICE (a flaw) gives SERABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Base in the sense of wretched or contemptible matches a pitiful, abject state.

clue.text: Next, start to sit on next seats

parts.note: the second next here is the later sol-fa note, so
the first next here follows mi in the scale: fa

indicators.note: the start of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An instruction: next, begin to sit on the next set of chairs.
explanation.walkthrough: Each 'next' moves one step up the sol-fa scale, so the first gives the earlier note; 'on' places that note and S after the later one.
explanation.definitionFit: Couches are upholstered seats for more than one person.

clue.text: Catch some piranha species

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Fishing for a few of a certain toothy fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A hinged metal fastening on a door or lid is a kind of catch.

clue.text: Next, in plainsong?

indicators.note: the note sits in the word for plain

parts.note: bald means plain, unadorned
the sol-fa note after so is la

explanation.surface: Is the next item in plainchant?
explanation.definitionFit: A narrative poem set to music is a kind of song.

clue.text: Extended discussions of next report on backing for beards

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the note is taken by its sound

parts.note: the sol-fa note after la is ti

indicators.note: the word is read backwards

parts.note: chins are what beards back, the backing for beards

explanation.surface: Long debates about the next report on how beards are supported.
explanation.walkthrough: TI said aloud gives TEA; CHINS, the backing for beards, is the second part.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal protest debates held at universities, often running long, are known by this name.

clue.text: Bent corners of next machine parts

parts.note: after ti the sol-fa scale returns to do
gears are machine parts

explanation.surface: Damaged edges on the next set of engine components.
explanation.definitionFit: Folded-down page corners in a book, likened to a hound's floppy lugs.

clue.text: Love binds one's beliefs

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
pinions means binds, ties someone's arms

explanation.surface: Love ties up whatever a person believes.
explanation.definitionFit: Views a person holds are their personal beliefs.

clue.text: Beast backing into grass

indicators.note: backing means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: a deer is a beast

explanation.surface: An animal reverses into long grass.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall waterside plant of the grass family.

clue.text: Disgust about next type of clothing

indicators.note: the word for disgust goes about the note

parts.note: to appal is to disgust
the sol-fa note after do is re

explanation.surface: Revulsion at the next fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Garments in general; clothing considered as a category.

clue.text: Clue to IRA high-explosive blast

parts.note: ..., that is the letters of air broken up, would give IRA

explanation.surface: A tip-off about a paramilitary bombing.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer read as wordplay, AIR BURST, is a clue whose solution is IRA.
explanation.definitionFit: A bomb or shell exploding in the air above its target.

clue.text: Foolish, mad, insane? Boatman's secret

indicators.note: the setter's letter is kept secret, tucked inside the other letters
mad signals the letters are jumbled

parts.note: Boatman is the setter, who refers to himself as I

explanation.surface: The setter confesses being silly and crazy.
explanation.walkthrough: INSANE jumbled to ASINNE, with I hidden inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Silly in the way of a donkey; utterly stupid.

clue.text: Lover puts weight on next

indicators.note: on puts the weight word after the note, as if laid upon it

parts.note: the sol-fa note after re is mi
stress means weight, emphasis

explanation.surface: A partner gives emphasis to what comes next.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman in an extramarital relationship is a lover.

clue.text: Perhaps cancer sufferer's last to be included in matter for discussion

indicators.note: the letter is included inside the word for a subject

parts.note: a topic is a matter for discussion

indicators.note: last means the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: A cancer patient's final days become a subject for debate.
explanation.walkthrough: Cancer is the Tropic of Cancer, not the disease.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tropic of Cancer is one example of a tropic line of latitude.

clue.text: Next flight is unusual

parts.note: the sol-fa note after mi is fa
a rout is a chaotic flight from battle

explanation.surface: The next plane journey is out of the ordinary.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for strange, avant-garde or way beyond normal.

clue.text: Idle chap taking note where point is lost

indicators.note: the word takes in a new letter
the compass point east, E, is lost from the word

parts.note: fellow means chap
A is a musical note

explanation.surface: A lazy man picks up a musical note but loses his point.
explanation.definitionFit: Land left fallow is idle, unplanted for a season.

clue.text: Boatman, uniform (Navy) on, gets release

parts.note: U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a hand is a crew member on a boat

explanation.surface: A sailor puts his navy uniform on and gets discharged.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' places HAND after U and N in the down column.
explanation.definitionFit: To let go of someone being held, a theatrical command to release.

clue.text: Disposed of next beast

indicators.note: of is weak; the note sits inside the word for disposed of

parts.note: to bin is to dispose of
the sol-fa note after fa is so

explanation.surface: An animal was got rid of next.
explanation.definitionFit: A large wild ox of the American plains is a beast.

clue.text: Next, caught in violent gunshot attack

indicators.note: the note is caught inside the jumbled letters
violent suggests letters thrown into disorder

parts.note: the sol-fa note after so is la

explanation.surface: The next person is caught in a vicious shooting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'violent' rearranges the weapon's report into ONSUGHT, and 'caught in' places the note inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A fierce assault or onrush is an attack.

clue.text: Free French one embraces next

indicators.note: the French word embraces the note, holding it within

parts.note: une is French for one (feminine)
the sol-fa note after la is ti

explanation.surface: A liberated Frenchwoman hugs whoever is next.
explanation.definitionFit: To loosen knots and so set something free.

clue.text: Backing miserable sinner taking next and last gram

indicators.note: the jumbled letters take in the note
miserable suggests the letters are wretchedly disordered

parts.note: after ti the scale returns to do

indicators.note: last means the final letter of the word

explanation.surface: Supporting a wretched wrongdoer who takes the next and final gram.
explanation.walkthrough: SINNER rearranged to ENRSIN takes DO; G from gram ends it.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving approval or support to something; backing it.
